text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Sweepy Tosho called me out.
When I arrived at the designated spot—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There you are, familiar!
'Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5', initiate operation!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I am Magical Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Actually, lately we've been
investigating magic-related rumors
and studying magic!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am Magical Dia♪
Which jinx's true identity shall we uncover today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, I'm truly looking forward to it.
As a professor, what kind of reagent... excuse me,
magical potion should I provide to lend you my aid!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "So with that in mind, you're coming along today too, familiar! It's part of your studies!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They're certainly a bunch with strong personalities...
I decide to follow along while keeping an eye on them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the "Wish-Granting Bird"
appeared around here, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait a second, Magical Dia!
A snake is aiming for that bird!
choice_data_list: If you rush out like that, it's dangerous—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Snake, Nakes, Ornithogalum... Serpents, heed my words!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Get away from there right now!
We have business with that bird!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, it left.
Good thing it was an obedient snake!
choice_data_list: (I have a feeling they were just startled by the loud voice, though.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the genius magical girl Sweepy...!
You stayed totally calm and collected!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Next is potion brewing!
Let's try making a 'medicine that makes your legs faster'!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The necessary ingredients are: the hardest-working honeybee,
and the fang of a lone wolf...
choice_data_list: Isn't it dangerous to go collecting them?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't be timid!
Great results always come with a few sacrifices!
Now then, let us go search for a beehive immediately—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stooop! If you get stung by a bee and catch a fever, running will be the least of your worries!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Never mistake recklessness for courage!"
Basic witch common sense!
First, we come up with a plan, then we make our move.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"How about this? We put the honeybees to sleep
and mark their backs with bright paint!
Then we can use that to spot the hardest workers!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Quite a constructive suggestion.
Shall I prepare some medicine to put the bees to sleep, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, the magical activities of "Sweepy 5" continued...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I guess that's all for today!
'Sweepy 5', dismissed for the day!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was fun!
Thanks for today, Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, no need to thank me, just keep devoting yourself!
And you, familiar over there, take some notes—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "What? What are you staring at me like that for!"
choice_data_list: I was just thinking you're doing a solid job as a leader.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she had tagged along on the magical investigation full of anxiety at first, Sweep Tosho took the initiative and tried to protect her friends. When I tell her that—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What about it?
Isn't that obvious!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it? I'm the top witch in this entire academy.
It's only natural for the strongest witch to take the lead!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma raised an inexperienced little girl like me
into someone this magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Protecting me when in danger, giving advice as a senior witch...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then it's my turn.
I'm going to nurture those budding magicians!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That is the duty of a first-rate mage.
Understood?
choice_data_list: I think that's a splendid mindset!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, our leader is so cool, isn't she!
She really has the kind of back you just want to follow!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can truly feel the resolve of someone who stands above others... That attitude is something I always strive to learn from♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, and it never gets boring. Please continue letting me observe... *ahem!* Please keep including me in your circle, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph...! If you're going to insist that much,
then I'll keep looking after you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's childish, she shows she can make calm judgments
and care deeply for her friends. Watching her, I thought...
choice_data_list: Now that's got a powerful boss vibe to it!
It's got a real powerful boss vibe, doesn't it!
You've really been thinking like a leader, huh.
You've really been thinking like a leader, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's childish, she shows she can make calm judgments
and care deeply for her friends. Watching her, I thought...
choice_data_list: Now that's got a powerful boss vibe to it!
It's got a real powerful boss vibe, doesn't it!
You've really been thinking like a leader, huh.
You've really been thinking like a leader, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, Boss~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I see! She's definitely cool and dependable... maybe even kind of like a boss!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo!
Call me a great sorceress already--!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A boss and a witch have totally different vibes, you knoooow?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am!
Who do you think you're talking to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san truly thinks about us, after all.
I'm so glad Trainer-san got to see that too.♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-Well... you could say it's a good chance to witness my genius firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it? As the familiar of this genius magical girl,
you'd better learn to think properly for yourself too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She strode off boldly after saying that.
She may be a handful, but seeing how much she cares for her peers
made me truly glad.
